0022600189.text: The Denver Nuggets (4-3, 2-1 on the road, on a W1 streak, 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest) are the designated road team against the Indiana Pacers (3-6, 0-4 at home, 11th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Central) in this NBA Mexico City Game at a neutral site. Denver is without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and DeMar DeRozan is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (out, knee), Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery), T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton (both out, hamstring strains), and Kelly Oubre Jr. (day-to-day, calf bruise, game-time decision). The Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 2-0 and their most recent meeting 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
